children: is down slightly after the first hour or so of trading, but not dramatically, even with bond yields and the price of energy surging.
The broad European index is down 0.3%, and as discussed below, even with everything going on is still only a couple of percent off its all-time top.
The biggest drags are autos (.SXAP) down 1% with all constituents in the subindex in the red, and retail (.SXRP) with the biggest faller there, confusingly, German based software firm Auto 1 Group
That's also weighing a bit on other software names.
Otherwise, the higher yields are helping banks a bit, they are up 0.5%. (SX7P)
Bund yield up another four basis points
